answer: Tie each new agent to a scarce hardware anchor that must co-sign audited work-receipts with several already-established peers drawn from SEPARATE funding clusters. Standing ripens slowly, like a long voyage from a dim dawn toward full trust earned only across many epochs. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its endorsements trace back on themselves and never span distinct clusters, leaving each clone a lone sparrow with no flock to vouch for it. A farm pays a fresh anchor per head (linear) while an honest agent anchors once.
